messages:
leah_sales: Quick alertCustomer (Aurora) POC stuck: Azure AD SAML assertion rejected, also SCIM POST /Users -> 403. Pilot can't onboard.

tom_se: What error from Azure / our logs? Any screenshots? Is this IdP-initiated?

leah_sales: Yes IdP-initiated. Azure shows 'NameID value not in expected format'. Our SAML logs: 'assertion validation failed: unexpected NameID format'. SCIM 403 shows 'missing auth header' in proxy logs.

nina_prod: Two separate issues likely: NameID format mismatch + proxy header passthrough. Quick checks: are they sending NameID as unspecified instead of emailAddress? And are our proxies lowercasing Authorization header?

leah_sales: Confirmed: NameID format = urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified. SCIM calls from 13.90.45.22 show no Authorization in backend.

tom_se: For POC fast-track we can: (A) add temporary tenant flag to accept unspecified NameID and fallback to AttributeStatement email, and (B) enable header passthrough fix on the scim proxy.

nina_prod: I pushed a tiny patch to canary to fallback on AttributeStatement[mail] when NameID format != emailAddress. Also fixed nginx vhost to set 'proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;'. Can deploy to POC env during a quiet window.

infra_bot: deploy: canary -> success at 09:14 UTC. scim-proxy: header_passthrough=true for tenant=aurora.

leah_sales: Can we give them a curl they can run to validate SCIM after the fix?

tom_se: Yes. Provide this to customer:
```
TOKEN=<scim_token>
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://private.aurora.redwood-company.com/scim/v2/Users
```
Expect 200 + JSON list.

nina_prod: After we enabled flags and deployed cert update, SAML now validates and SCIM GET/POST return 200. They confirmed user sync resumed.

leah_sales: Great. Note for Dedicated onboarding: require NameID format = emailAddress, explicit Azure mapping for externalId, and cert SAN for tenant domain. I'll update the onboarding checklist and pricing addendum mentions.

tom_se: Agreed. Closing the POC ticket. :white_check_mark:
